sampling: Uniform 32-frame whole-clip samples; two chronological nonoverlapping 16-frame windows; average pooled encoder vectors
preprocessing: Official weights transform: RGB, resize [128,171], center crop [112,112], mean [0.43216,0.394666,0.37645], std [0.22803,0.22145,0.216989]
ensemble: Equal mean of five head scores; mean of fixed crowd-validation thresholds
limitations: Exploratory transfer to previously evaluated RWF footage. No RWF fitting, normalization, threshold optimization or model selection. Primary head is crowd fold 1 by fixed convention, not selected for test performance. Other crowd fold heads and a predeclared equal-weight ensemble are supplementary. The ensemble threshold is the arithmetic mean of the five crowd-validation-selected thresholds. Scores are not calibrated probabilities. No supervised RWF or untouched benchmark claim is made; pretraining/source overlap is unaudited.
